title: Harvest Pumpkin Tapestry Table runner and placemats
text: Harvest Pumpkin Tapestry Table runner and placemats. This is a really pretty set. The tapestry type material is thick and the colors are rich and deep.  It is slightly more deep red than I expected in person, but i like it and brings Fall decor into my home. You get 4 placemats and 1 table runner.  Having said all of this, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Harvest Pumpkin Tapestry Table Runner and Placemats, Set of 5
features: Decorate your home for autumn with our 5-piece harvest pumpkin table linen set
Set includes 1 woven tapestry table runner and 4 matching placemats
Table linens are done in warm autumn colors and feature classic fall imagery. Burgundy fabric backing.
Perfect for setting your table on Thanksgiving, or any day during the fall
Size: Runner: 72" x 13". Placemats: 19" x 13". Polyester/cotton.
description: Get in the autumn spirit with our 5-piece table runner and placemat set! Featuring warm colors and classic fall imagery such as pumpkins and leaves, this set is ideal for Thanksgiving and all season long.
